expiryNote: Set an expiry when creating it; project API keys never expire.
minimalPermission: This is the account access token the Supabase CLI and Management API use; it has the account's full power, so give it an expiry. For an app's own database access use the project's Settings → API Keys instead: publishable (sb_publishable_) for clients, secret (sb_secret_) only on a server.
